schema_absence_proof.statement: With exposure:codemode the six tools appear in NO model-visible tool declaration (toolsAdded = 13 entries, none browser-fleet) and their JSON inputSchema objects (1198 B) are absent; the codemode description carries only name + one-line description + compact TS type signatures (6 'codemode tool declaration' blocks, 0 JSON-schema markers). With exposure:direct the schemas appear inline as parameters JSON in the declarations (+640 tok).

honest_nuances: TS-type signatures of the nested tools ARE present as text inside the codemode tool description; what is kept out is the tools' JSON Schema declarations (the API-level tool entries).

Per-turn token economy is NOT savings for this small server: codemode costs +4517 tok/turn vs +640 for direct declarations (the 9147 B codemode scaffold dominates). The schema-out property is structural (big tool lists stay out of the tools array; declarations share a token budget), and is a win for large servers, not for six tools.
arm C (direct) does not activate codemode at all in 0.99.1; its +640 tok is purely the six schema-bearing declarations.
